title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-25
lineage: CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent Miller soundboard captures an average 1971 show with a soaring China > Rider and a standout Beat It On Down the Line‑9, though overall energy is modest.
ai_review.review: The recording, sourced from Miller’s soundboard, is clear and well‑balanced despite some monitor problems that affect the first set’s continuity. Musically the concert is an average ’71 performance, with highlights like China > Rider and Beat It On Down the Line‑9, while tracks such as Bertha fall flat.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is judged average to below average by one detailed review, offset by a very enthusiastic short review; recording quality is rated excellent, yielding an overall rating around 3.7.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller source noted as excellent – clear, balanced soundboard tape, though first‑set monitor problems cause some mix issues.

standout_songs: Beat It On Down the Line-9
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set suffers from monitor problems that disrupt continuity; second set is uneven, with a few high points but generally average performance.
